description: Income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
income_criteria: No general income ceiling; specified exclusion categories apply.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families identified by State/UT authorities, subject to exclusion criteria; eKYC is mandatory for registered farmers.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments.
documents_required: Identity/Aadhaar details, bank details and land/farmer records as required.
application_process: Use New Farmer Registration on the PM-KISAN portal and complete verification/eKYC.

description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to eligible women from poor households.
target_group: Adult women from eligible poor households
income_criteria: Poor-household status is established through the prescribed declaration/eligibility categories.
eligibility: Adult woman; no other LPG connection in the same household; applicable poor-household conditions.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection; first refill and stove/hotplate as specified by the scheme.
documents_required: KYC, Aadhaar, family-composition/ration-card proof, address proof where required, bank details and declaration.
application_process: Apply online through PMUY or at an LPG distributor.

description: National financial-inclusion mission providing basic banking and access to credit, insurance and pension.
target_group: Unbanked persons and financially excluded households
eligibility: Persons without another basic bank account can open a basic savings bank deposit account through a bank branch or Business Correspondent.
benefits: Basic account, no minimum balance, RuPay card, accident insurance subject to conditions and eligible overdraft facility.
documents_required: Aadhaar or other officially valid KYC documents.
application_process: Approach a participating bank branch or Business Correspondent/Bank Mitra.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Government-funded health assurance scheme for eligible families.
age_criteria: No general age limit for eligible family members.
income_criteria: Eligibility is based on the PM-JAY beneficiary identification criteria.
eligibility: Eligibility is determined through the applicable PM-JAY database and government criteria.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage at empanelled hospitals subject to current scheme rules.
documents_required: Beneficiary identification/ID and documents requested during verification.
application_process: Check eligibility through official PM-JAY beneficiary channels and use the verified beneficiary identification for treatment.

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Credit-support scheme for eligible street vendors.
age_criteria: No general age criterion stated in the core scheme description.
income_criteria: No general income ceiling is the primary criterion.
eligibility: Street vendors meeting the scheme's identification and verification requirements.
benefits: Working-capital loan support with incentives and higher loan tranches subject to current rules and repayment.
documents_required: Identity/KYC and vending-related proof or identification.
application_process: Apply through PM SVANidhi, a participating lender or designated facilitation channel.

description: Support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople in notified trades.
age_criteria: Generally at least 18 years at registration.
income_criteria: No single universal income ceiling; scheme conditions apply.
eligibility: Eligible self-employed artisans/craftspeople working in a notified traditional trade and satisfying scheme conditions.
benefits: Recognition, skill training, toolkit support, credit support, digital-transaction incentives and marketing support.
documents_required: Aadhaar/identity details and information required during registration and verification.
application_process: Registration through the official PM Vishwakarma system/CSC channels followed by verification.

description: Urban housing assistance for eligible households under notified components.
income_criteria: EWS up to Rs. 3 lakh; LIG above Rs. 3 lakh to Rs. 6 lakh; MIG above Rs. 6 lakh to Rs. 9 lakh annual household income, subject to guidelines.
eligibility: Eligible urban families with no pucca house anywhere in the country and meeting PMAY-U 2.0 conditions.
benefits: Housing assistance under the applicable PMAY-U 2.0 vertical.
documents_required: Identity, address, income and housing/beneficiary documents as required.
application_process: Apply through PMAY-U 2.0/urban local body and complete validation.

description: Rural housing assistance for eligible rural households needing a pucca house.
income_criteria: Based on deprivation/household criteria and official beneficiary selection.
eligibility: Eligible rural households selected according to PMAY-G guidelines and verified through the prescribed process.
benefits: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca rural house, with permitted convergence support.
documents_required: Identity, household and bank-account information and other verification records.
application_process: Beneficiaries are identified and verified through the prescribed rural-local-government process.

description: Skill-development programme supporting training and certification under notified components.
target_group: Indian candidates seeking eligible skill training/certification
income_criteria: Usually not a universal income-based criterion.
eligibility: Candidates meeting the current PMKVY component, course and training-centre requirements.
benefits: Skill training, assessment and certification/support as provided by the applicable component.
application_process: Find an eligible course/training centre through the official skill-development ecosystem and register.

description: Credit scheme supporting eligible micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises.
age_criteria: Subject to lender and applicable MUDRA rules.
eligibility: Eligible micro enterprises engaged in income-generating activities and meeting lender/MUDRA requirements.
benefits: Institutional credit under applicable MUDRA loan categories.
documents_required: KYC, business/enterprise details and financial documents required by lender.
application_process: Approach a participating bank/NBFC/MFI or lending channel and submit a loan application.

description: Facilitates bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises promoted by women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
income_criteria: No universal household-income ceiling; enterprise and lending criteria apply.
eligibility: Eligible SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs meeting scheme and lending conditions for a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises within notified scheme terms.
documents_required: KYC, category/gender proof where applicable, project/business documents and financial information.
application_process: Apply through Stand-Up India or a participating bank and complete lender appraisal.

description: Government-backed accident insurance scheme through participating bank/post-office channels.
eligibility: Eligible individual with a participating account who meets current enrolment conditions.
benefits: Accident insurance benefit for death or specified permanent disability under current terms.
documents_required: Account details and consent/auto-debit enrolment information; KYC as required.
application_process: Opt in through a participating bank/post office during the enrolment period.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Government-backed one-year renewable life insurance scheme through participating bank/post-office channels.
eligibility: Eligible individual with a participating account who meets current age and enrolment conditions.
benefits: Life insurance cover for death from any cause, subject to current policy terms.
documents_required: Account details, consent/auto-debit information and KYC as required.
application_process: Opt in through a participating bank/post office during the enrolment period.

description: Voluntary contribution-based pension scheme with a government-guaranteed minimum pension after age 60.
income_criteria: From 1 Oct 2022, a person who is or has been an income-tax payer on the application date cannot open a new APY account.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18-40 with a savings bank/post-office savings account and meeting current APY conditions.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60 depending on chosen pension and contributions; spouse/nominee benefits apply under scheme rules.
documents_required: Savings account details, enrolment information and KYC documents required by bank/post office.
application_process: Approach the bank/post office where the savings account is held and complete APY enrolment.

description: Government small-savings scheme for a girl child for long-term savings.
age_criteria: Account may be opened for a girl child who has not attained 10 years on the opening date.
income_criteria: No general income ceiling stated in scheme rules.
eligibility: Eligible girl child account holder and guardian meeting Sukanya Samriddhi rules.
benefits: Long-term government small-savings account with interest and tax treatment under applicable rules.
documents_required: Girl child's birth certificate and KYC/account-opening documents.
application_process: Open the account through a post office or authorised bank using the prescribed process.
